name: Paroxetine
summary: Paroxetine is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) antidepressant.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Extensively metabolized, with CYP2D6 contributing. Oxidation and conjugation produce metabolites with little relevant activity; elimination occurs in urine and feces, mainly as metabolites.
